It operates four brands, “ATAO (Atao),” “IANNE (Ianne),” “ILEMER (Irumēru)” and “StrawberryMe (Sutoroberī Mī),” and sells products through store sales, internet sales and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥4,126 million.
